source_lattice_proof.tail_argument: K has max coordinate1+sqrt2<5/2. If Bz lies in2K then ||z||infinity<=||B^-1||infinity*||Bz||infinity<5||B^-1||infinity<4, so the integer word lies in[-3,3]^3. Every nonzero such word has the listed exact strict separating face.

construction.physical_operation: Select complete source cells at a marked primitive-cell midpoint, retain a realized directed face separator for every pair, and close all24 common host walls. Continue only separators exposed by the actual previous complete state. Every owner retains identity frame.
construction.native_decoder: Multiply exact rational centers by100000001/100000000 and store binary64 numeric values; use identity quaternions. The outward host scale is idealS*(1+1e-8)+1e-8. All native numeric inputs are checked as exact rationals.
